capabilities: Open and inspect every currently supported file type.
Preview, inspection, search, themes, accessibility, and other normal application usability.
Basic Office document metadata editing for Title, Subject, Author, Keywords, Comments, Category, and Company.
Mandatory safe backups where an edit requires them, plus normal history and undo safety.
free_baseline.implementation_rule: Free is compiled into MetaTweak. No token, account, license key, activation, JWKS, API call, or feature-grant response may gate startup or these capabilities.

document_metadata.client_rule: This ID may appear in optional resolver output but mirrors the local Free baseline and must never be required to unlock it.

capabilities: Embedded metadata editing for JPEG, JPG, TIFF, and TIF
future non-Office embedded formats explicitly added to this capability
extended_file_type_editing.free_exclusions: Opening, inspection, and basic filesystem information are not gated. Basic Office document metadata editing remains Free.

capabilities: disable-backup options only where the application declares them safe
advanced_backup_controls.free_exclusions: Mandatory safety backups, normal history, and undo remain Free.

capabilities: Automatic cleanup and retention management for safety backups
Apply supported changes across multiple files
Save and reuse editing presets or templates
Windows Explorer context-menu and Open With workflow integration

lifecycle.free_installation: Do not register or expose paid shell commands.
lifecycle.activated_pro: Register per-user shell entries after a valid entitlement is available, or enable installed infrastructure only then.
lifecycle.pro_deactivation_or_fallback: Remove or disable paid shell entries and return to the Free baseline without misleading non-functional commands.

deprecated_feature_ids.all_file_types: Replaced by extended_file_type_editing; opening and inspection are never gated.
deprecated_feature_ids.file_attributes: Not implemented in the current product and is not granted or consumed.
deprecated_feature_ids.backup_controls: Replaced by advanced_backup_controls; basic safety backups remain Free.
deprecated_feature_ids.advanced_operations: Too broad. Copy date maps to datetime_editing, version-label removal maps to advanced_metadata, and history/undo remain Free.

required_client_state.installation_id: Persist a random UUID generated once per installed application instance.
required_client_state.activation_token: Persist securely only after successful Pro activation; use for validate and deactivate.
required_client_state.entitlement_token: Cache only after successful paid activation or validation; absence always falls back to the built-in Free baseline.
required_client_state.verification_keys: Cache the public verification keys returned with successful paid activation or validation.
required_client_state.last_validation: Optional local scheduling metadata only; it is not authorization for a perpetual license.

prohibited_client_dependencies: price, activation-limit, refresh timing, or server feature-grant business rules
